status: Production late-name baseline repair, narrower lookup and driver-provenance binding integrated; release gates remain open

late_name_fix.problem: On the second spelling update, transcript correction still used the earliest ASR as authority, but document replacement ranges were incorrectly based on that old text rather than the currently cited revision.
late_name_fix.change: Keep the original-derived target. Use replacements derived from the current cited source only if normalizing that current source yields exactly the same authoritative target. Otherwise retain the existing fail-closed replay.
late_name_fix.real_red: First CEDAR LEDGER→CEDARLEDGER succeeded; second CEDARLEDGER→CedarLedger updated source but left old minutes. The same regression now passes.
late_name_fix.controls: Consecutive source/citation/history revisions, no added inference jobs; human/accepted/stale/wrong quote/shared-prefix/removed term/new substantive note protections retained.

lookup.change: Engine::terminology uses terminology_entries(), loading persisted term rows in the original stable order and visibility; it no longer materializes all historical meetings and notes. No cache or admission-rule change.
lookup.scope: 320 historical meetings/320x64KiB notes,120x24KiB unrelated library entries,40 terms;7 warm repetitions; fingerprints/hotwords equal. Not ASR accuracy, whole-app latency, RSS or energy proof.

driver_binding.problem: Linux module version or kernel+boot strings were nonempty, so old code treated them as persistent userspace driver identity.
driver_binding.change: The helper records driver-version provenance. Only the existing Windows DXGI user-mode version with nonempty versions remains persistent; Linux kernel-only, old-helper and unknown provenance bind to the current app-session nonce. The hardware-key schema changes and CUDA compatibility version participates, invalidating older certificates.
driver_binding.remaining: This does not detect every userspace library/env change during one running app, replace the30s probe cache with observers, or implement Vulkan driverUUID/CUDA loaded-library fingerprinting. No Linux GPU execution/OOM/reset performance claim.

official_sources.supports: driverUUID identifies the driver build in use; raw kernel metadata is not this userspace identity.
cuDriverGetVersion reports supported CUDA API version, not a graphics-driver build identifier.
CheckInterfaceSupport with IDXGIDevice returns a user-mode driver version.

limits: No generative model call, SDK/model download, GPU package or native installer build for these fixes.
Existing Q16 remainsFAIL and0.3.5 is unpublished; no rejected source-unit producer promoted.
The full P0/P1/P2/P3/G1/G2 objective remains active; ASR pause hotword ordering still requires separate fixed-source native verification.
